name: phone-use
description: Drive the apps on your Android phone from the desktop agent: launch an app, read the screen as a screenshot or an accessibility tree, tap, swipe, type Chinese text and press system keys - on a virtual display shown live in a window on your computer, where you can take over at any time. The phone only needs USB debugging: the plugin runs its own server over adb and installs nothing on the phone.
author: Akira
exampleQueries: Set up Phone Use for my phone
Open Settings on my phone and tell me the Android version
On my phone, search Douban for highly rated movies this week
